courses.subject: S C
courses.title: Intensive Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian I
courses.description: Not open to native or heritage speakers of Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian. Emphasis on developing oral proficiency in Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian using intensive methods of instruction. Six lecture hours a week for one semester. Serbian/Croatian 601C and 506 may not both be counted. Serbian/Croatian 601C and 507 may not both be counted.

courses.subject: S C
courses.title: First-Year Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian I
courses.description: Emphasis on proficiency in four skills: listening, speaking, reading, and writing. Five lecture hours a week for one semester. Serbian/Croatian 601C and 506 may not both be counted.

courses.subject: S C
courses.title: First-Year Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian II
courses.description: Emphasis on proficiency in four skills: listening, speaking, reading, and writing. Five lecture hours a week for one semester. Serbian/Croatian 601C and 507 may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Serbian/Croatian 506.

courses.subject: S C
courses.title: Intensive Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian II
courses.description: Not open to native or heritage speakers of Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian. Continuing intensive development of proficiency in Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian, with a focus on speaking and the reading of authentic texts. Six lecture hours a week for one semester. Serbian/Croatian 611C and 312K may not both be counted. Serbian/Croatian 611C and 312L may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Serbian/Croatian 601C or 507.

courses.subject: S C
courses.title: Second-Year Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian I
courses.description: Listening, speaking, reading, and writing at the second-year level. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Serbian/Croatian 611C and 312K may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Serbian/Croatian 601C or 507.

courses.subject: S C
courses.title: Second-Year Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian II
courses.description: Listening, speaking, reading, and writing at the advanced, second-year level. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Serbian/Croatian 611C and 312L may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Serbian/Croatian 312K.

courses.subject: S C
courses.title: Topics in Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian Studies
courses.description: Selected aspects of Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian history and culture. Conducted in English. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Varies with the topic.

courses.subject: S C
courses.title: Third-Year Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian I
courses.description: Oral expression, reading, and composition. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Serbian/Croatian 611C or 312L.

courses.subject: S C
courses.title: Third-Year Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian II
courses.description: Oral expression, reading, and composition. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Serbian/Croatian 325.

courses.subject: S C
courses.title: Conference Course in Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian
courses.description: Conference course. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Serbian/Croatian 312K and 312L and consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Serbian/Croatian 312K and 312L and consent of instructor.

courses.subject: S C
courses.title: Topics in Bosnian, Croatian, and Serbian Language
courses.description: Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Graduate standing and consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing and consent of instructor.

courses.subject: S C
courses.title: Conference Course
courses.description: Study of individual problems in Serbian and Croatian languages, literature, and culture. Conference course. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in the Department of Slavic and Eurasian Studies, or graduate standing and consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing in the Department of Slavic and Eurasian Studies, or graduate standing and consent of instructor.
